cards.name: Pull from Eternity
cards.oracleText: Put target face-up exiled card into its owner's graveyard.

cards.name: Pulling Teeth
cards.oracleText: Clash with an opponent. If you win, target player discards two cards. Otherwise, that player discards a card. (Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts that card on their choice of the top or bottom. A player wins if their card had a greater mana value.)

cards.name: Pull Under
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn.

cards.name: Pull from the Deep
cards.oracleText: Return up to one target instant card and up to one target sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand. Exile Pull from the Deep.

cards.name: Pull Through the Weft
cards.oracleText: Return up to two target nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand, then return up to two target land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Pull from Tomorrow
cards.oracleText: Draw X cards, then discard a card.

cards.name: Pull of the Mist Moon
Push // Pull
cards.oracleText:
Destroy target tapped creature.
Put up to two target creature cards from a single graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. They gain haste until end of turn. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Pull from the Grave
cards.oracleText: Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to your hand. You gain 2 life.
